_about: The ontology's identity: its release rises on every published change, `extends` names what it composes on top of, `carries` what the directory holds.
name: oto-core
summary: The temporal vocabulary every OTO ontology rests on, and the one class every fact cites: Document.

changelog.note: The sample documents carry their date as as_of, not as an undeclared `date` attribute; an extender that declares attributes on Document composed a sample it could not check.
Ships its competency questions (questions.json): every class, relation and attribute is cited by a question that runs, and the sample answers each one it must.
Declares its namespace: its terms keep one IRI in the RDF export of every project that uses it.
Action, acts_on and executed_by join the core; the status `intended` for a fact asserted as a plan; the policy rule intended-fact-overdue.
Split out of the four shipped ontologies, which now extend it.
